summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, reporting its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results via press release and Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement. The filing includes forward-looking statements and describes the company's weighted voting rights structure with Class A and Class B ordinary shares, as well as its Nasdaq-listed American depositary shares. It is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation events such as mergers, tenders, or strategic changes. The contents are limited to financial results and standard cautionary language, warranting no special-situations classification.
